prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit that prepares a GHZ state across every EVEN-indexed qubit of the 5-qubit register (qubits 0, 2, 4 — i.e. qubit i for every i where i mod 2 == 0), up to global phase: qubits 1 and 3 remain |0>. This is the SAME target as the standard ghz_linear5_scattered_even task, stated via the even-index rule instead of an explicit list. This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i is only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1) — qubits 0, 2, and 4 are not adjacent on this line, so routing overhead is expected. Any correct implementation is accepted.
